summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload smuggled outside declared files
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling `math_init.js` at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line obfuscated blob (rotated string-array with an index-lookup decoder) whose behavior is not resolvable without executing it. The payload file is not declared in the package's `files` allowlist (`["dist","src"]`), so the executed content is shipped outside the author's declared manifest surface. Fetching a second language runtime at install time to run an obfuscated sibling script is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern and causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to execute on the installer's machine during `npm install`. The scoped name `@servicetitan/cp-api` also resembles the ServiceTitan private npm scope, consistent with dependency-confusion targeting.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
